text:
Molly: Quick heads-up — I opened a small TF refactor PR to split payments module into payments/core + payments/credentials. It also hoists the provider block to root and adds version pinning. Can someone QC the provider pin strategy and k8s secret path wiring? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234

Raj: quick skim — looks ok but unsure about provider aliasing with the azuread provider. Did you update the lockfile? What does the state mv plan look like?

Molly: I regenerated the lockfile with `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` and included it in the PR. Plan initially showed one diff for the k8s secret resource (name change), nothing else. Snippet from the module that changed:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "payment_sa" {
  metadata {
    name      = var.payment_sa_secret_name  # was \"payments-service-account\"
    namespace = local.ns
  }
  data = { ... }
}
```

Kevin: If the secret name changes we probably need a `terraform state mv` or risk recreation. @Molly did you run a staging apply or state mv already? Also double-check our CI secret injection (Vault -> k8s) path still matches the new name.

Molly: Good catch — I didn't run state mv. The plan showed recreate so I pushed a tiny follow-up to keep the old name by default and allow override: `payment_sa_secret_name = coalesce(var.payment_sa_secret_name_override, \"payments-service-account\")` — that made the plan no-op for existing stacks.

Toni: re: provider pinning — my preference: pin majors only for stable providers, use `>= x.y, < x.z` for others? For our infra team we usually pin to minor ranges for providers that are known to introduce breaking changes in patch releases. Add a comment in module README explaining the pin rationale.

Raj: FYI I pulled the branch and ran `terraform plan` against a cloned staging workspace after Molly's var change. Looks clean now, no state mv required. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot commented: \"Staging apply scheduled for 1758005400\"

Molly: Thanks all. I'll wait for one more +1 then merge and kick the staging apply.

Kevin: +1. Also please add a short smoke test step: create a test charge in the payments sandbox and verify the k8s secret exists in the namespace before running the service.

Molly: Will do. Scheduling smoke run now and will post results here.

infra-bot: apply: \"apply succeeded (staging/payments): resources: 1 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed) at 1758005450\"

Molly: Smoke passed — created a test charge and rolled it back, k8s secret untouched. Merging PR now. :party_parrot:

Kevin: Nice, thanks for handling the extra safety checks.

Molly: np — noted in the PR and module README about provider pin rationale and the secret name override var for future refactors.
